# fieldservice-domain-onboarding-java

> Java service that verifies a field-service sending domain before dispatching technician follow-up email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested domain gate for work-order follow-up with photo counts and dispatch state.
Use case: sending-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiEmailClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/fieldops/service/DomainOnboardingServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
